additions.name: MIRAIT ONE Shinkiba Liquid-Cooled Container Demonstrator

status.summary: MIRAIT ONE reports that its 20-foot liquid-cooled container at the Shinkiba building is installed and undergoing GPU-equipment testing. This is a completed installation for demonstration and testing; a commercial service opening has not been confirmed.

locator.precision: Named MIRAIT Shinkiba host-building property point at 2-15-20 Shinkiba. The installed container is reported within these premises; its exact outdoor position and footprint are not mapped. The office building is not itself asserted to be a dedicated data center.
locator.identity_review: The October 13 and July 3 MIRAIT ONE reports explicitly place this installed container on the company’s Shinkiba Building property. The operator’s group directory and MIRAIT Mobile East access page identify that named building at 2-15-20 Shinkiba. The access page’s original Google embed resolves the exact named host building and address, with a selected-object coordinate separate from the input viewport. The floor 7 office and headquarters are not assumed to be the data center; the separate container reports establish its physical presence at this host property.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Google supplies no measured positional accuracy or displacement from the selected host-building point to the installed container. Coordinate decimal precision is not survey accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: All serialized fields screened across 430 sites, 456 projects, 2324 evidence and 231 original records plus identity mapping. No identity/source collision. All current site/project geometry envelopes and original coordinates checked. Nearest recorded site is CEC Tokyo No.2 Data Center (Sunshine 60) at 13733.2 m. See dedup-review.json.
additions.successor_review: The July 3 source already reported installation. The October 13 corporate article describes the installed equipment and present testing; it is a confirmation, not a new completion event. The September-or-later demonstration-service target from July is not promoted to achieved commercial operation. The March 18, 2025 lab opening is separate from this container.

scoped_project_details.facility_scope: One installed 20-foot liquid-cooled container for demonstration and equipment verification on MIRAIT ONE Shinkiba Building premises. The wider building and every lab unit are not separate data centers.
scoped_project_details.selected_observation_date_semantics: October 13 corporate publication explicitly describes current equipment verification; article refers to a September 11 video whose filming date is undisclosed.
scoped_project_details.cooling: Delta GoCool-80 liquid-to-air CDU; no external primary-water circuit.
scoped_project_details.capacity_scope: October article envisages up to 96 kW cooling; July report gives an 80 kW CDU and three 30 kW in-row units. These are differently dated/scoped cooling figures and are not aggregated or converted to IT MW.
scoped_project_details.role_scope: MIRAIT ONE installs and conducts the demonstration facility. MORGENROT participates in joint laboratory research; a separate property-owner or current container-operator role is not inferred.
